explanation: This slide represents a visual representation or further detail of Mendel's monohybrid cross, in which parental plants of differing traits (like tall vs. short) are crossed to study the segregation of a single gene.

questions.q: In Mendel's monohybrid cross of tall and short pea plants, what trait was typically observed in all F1 offspring?
questions.exp: Option C is correct because the dominant trait (tall) masks the recessive trait (short) in the F1 heterozygous generation.
